recommendations.population: Meta Lead Ads commercial matched traffic.
recommendations.primary_metric: A/B lead rate and Tier A count in COMMERCIAL matched.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not reduce total qualified A/B volume below the current monthly baseline.
recommendations.expected_direction: Higher A/B density and stable qualified volume.
recommendations.success_criterion: A/B rate improves with no loss in Tier A count.
recommendations.evidence_dependency: Future BigQuery MCP evidence at the same grain.
recommendations.uncertainty: Association is observed; causal lift must be tested.
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: Stop if C/D share rises or commercial volume collapses.
